text.p: Joe Royle factfile:
Born: Liverpool April 1949.
July 1965: Signs professional forms with Everton after playing
at the club as a schoolboy and junior.
January 1966: Makes his debut for Everton as a 16-year-old v
Blackpool
May 1970: Wins a League Championship medal
February 1971: Makes his England debut v Malta.
December 1974: Moves to Manchester City.
March 1977: Makes the last of his England appearances.
August 1980: Moves to Norwich.
April 1982: Announces his retirement as a player.
July 1982: Takes over as Oldham manager.
April 1990: Oldham reach F.A. Cup semifinals and League Cup
final.
May 1991: Royle leads Oldham into the first division.
November 1994: Royle leaves Oldham for Everton as Mike Walker
is sacked.
May 1995: Everton win the F.A. Cup, beating Manchester United.
January 1997: Everton suffer surprise F.A. Cup exit against
Bradford.
March 1997: Quits Everton by mutal consent.
